scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'if [ "${CI:-}" = "true" ]; then exit 0; fi; rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "ERROR: Use pnpm to install in this workspace (CI environments are exempt)." >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "!./artifacts/mockup-sandbox" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
